name: physical_forward_model
error:
Validation failed for tool "physical_forward_model":
  - action_id: must have required properties action_id

Received arguments:
{}

evidence: Receiving DO2 10.0 mg/L at 48.0 h dropping to 2.99 mg/L at 48.2 h and 1.80 mg/L at 52.0 h, below minimum_do_mg_l=2.0
Source batches 1-3 maintained DO2 >= ~7.4 mg/L through the equivalent window, showing receiving process divergence at 48 h
Forward model at 52 h: estimated transfer multiplier 0.438, change at 48 h
Model comparison: keep min DO 1.03 / deficit 5.11 mg.h/L; increase_air 0.89 / 8.23; combined 0.99 / 6.54; strong_feed_reduction 1.16 / 3.88 with highest product mass ~172.6 kg
Delayed assays show product rising (P=2.82 g/L at 48 h), indicating an active culture whose oxygen demand can be reduced
args.rationale: At 48 h the receiving DO2 abruptly collapsed from ~10 to ~2 mg/L and is at 1.8 mg/L at the 52 h decision point, violating the 2.0 mg/L oxygen minimum. The forward model estimates the oxygen transfer multiplier fell to ~0.44 at 48 h, indicating impaired transfer rather than simply elevated demand. Because kLa-side interventions (increase_air, combined) are transfer-limited in the model and yield only marginal DO2 improvement while still violating constraints, reducing the oxygen demand side is the only effective lever. Strong feed reduction (0.6 feed, 1.15 air) gives the best predicted minimum DO (1.16 vs 1.03 keep), the smallest post-decision oxygen deficit (3.88 vs 5.11 mg·h/L keep), and the highest retained product mass (~172.6 kg), retaining production while minimizing further oxygen-constraint violation. Stop is rejected because it zeroes counted production; keep and increase_air leave larger oxygen deficits.
args.uncertainty: All actions remain nominally infeasible in the source-calibrated model (min DO 0.76-1.58 across sensitivity members), so this is harm reduction with residual constraint violation, not full recovery; the model is imperfect and calibrated on source batches, while the hidden receiving realization may differ (actual transfer impairment mechanism and reversibility unknown). Delayed assay data ends at 48 h, so current biomass/product state is uncertain; if the DO2 drop were due to a sensor artifact the feed cut would sacrifice some productivity.
